contexts.text: The atmospheres... which are actuated in power by the sun.
Earths could not otherwise be actuated and produce forms of uses.
Waters and earths there... are actuated and modified by the heat and light of the spiritual sun.
The perfection of forces is the perfection of all things that are actuated and moved by life.
The substances contiguous to his body continually actuated by the heart and lungs...
The atmospheres in ultimates become such forces, by which the substances and matters, such as are in earths, are actuated into forms...
Forms of the mineral kingdom... actuated by the sun...
The Lord, by influx from Himself, actuates all things of the soul and of the mind, and actuates by an influx of love and wisdom. TCR 570:6.
The Divine life which by influx from the sun of Heaven actuates man...
The soul which actuates what is natural...
The spiritual world operates from within and actuates everything that exists in the world of nature.
